title: The Gold Standard in Landscape Lighting
body_markdown:
August 19, 2026


*Our partner,[Beacon Outdoor Lighting (opens in a new tab)](https://beaconoutdoorlighting.com/) , recently published a case study highlighting this[Sollos (opens in a new tab)](https://www.hayward.com/why-hayward/explore-products/better-landscape-lighting) lighting installation.*


***A Case Study on Sollos’s Copper Fixtures at Pelican Bay Beach – Beacon Outdoor Lighting -*** ***Sollos Landscape Lighting - Halco Lamps***


**Project Overview**


In the exclusive coastal community of Pelican Bay in Naples, Florida,[Beacon Outdoor Lighting (opens in a new tab)](https://beaconoutdoorlighting.com/) was brought in to completely redesign a luxury property’s lighting system. The homeowner had installed a new system within the last 24 months but was extremely disappointed with its weak light output, inconsistent illumination, and poor fixture design and placement. When our design team arrived, it was clear the system didn’t just need more lights — it needed better design and higher-quality components.


To achieve the warm, timeless, and high-performance look the client envisioned,[Beacon (opens in a new tab)](https://beaconoutdoorlighting.com/) specified[Sollos copper fixtures (opens in a new tab)](https://www.hayward.com/why-hayward/explore-products/better-landscape-lighting) for aesthetic cohesion and durability, paired with Halco 8-watt LED lamps for exceptional brightness and beam quality. This pairing created the perfect blend of craftsmanship, performance, and architectural harmony.


---


**Project Goals**


Our design objectives were focused and deliberate:


● **Architectural Integrity:** Match the home’s existing copper lanterns and classical design.


● **Performance:** Deliver full-canopy illumination for tall trees and expansive landscapes.


● **Longevity:** Use premium materials capable of withstanding coastal Florida’s harsh climate.


● **Aesthetic Balance:** Restore the elegance and depth that the original system lacked.


---


**Design Approach**


The home sits on a beautifully landscaped lot filled with mature Sylvester palms, oak trees, and ornamental plantings. Each element deserved to shine after sunset.


**● Architecture** : We installed **15 architectural up-lights** to beautifully illuminate the front façade of the home, enhancing its architectural details and creating a striking visual balance with the surrounding landscape.


**● Front Landscape:** We created a multi-layered lighting composition for depth and visual interest. Each palm & mature canopy was illuminated from a minimum of three angles for complete canopy coverage, eliminating dark voids and creating an even, natural glow across the property.


**● Rear Landscape:** We mirrored the same technique to ensure visual consistency, using Halco’s 8-watt LED lamps in[Sollos copper up-lights (opens in a new tab)](https://www.hayward.com/why-hayward/explore-products/better-landscape-lighting) to achieve full-canopy illumination. Lighting intensity was balanced to enhance beauty without glare or hot spots. The result was a cohesive, elegant lighting design that accentuates both the landscape and the architecture.


---


**Why Copper?**


Copper wasn’t just chosen for its beauty — it was also chosen for its performance advantages.


**Key Benefits of Sollos Copper Fixtures:**


● **Superior Thermal Management:** Copper dissipates heat faster than brass or stainless steel, allowing the fixture to cool quickly.


● **Extended Lamp Life:** Cooler fixtures extend LED longevity and ensure consistent brightness.


● **Natural Aging:** Over time, the copper develops a rich patina that blends seamlessly into the landscape and in this case matched the existing coach lights.


● **Durability:** Copper resists corrosion, making it ideal for Florida’s coastal environment. We often refer to[Sollos (opens in a new tab)](https://www.hayward.com/why-hayward/explore-products/better-landscape-lighting) as *“the gold standard in landscape lighting”* for good reason. Their copper fixtures combine engineering precision with timeless elegance — perfectly suited for the luxury properties we illuminate.


---


**Power & Control**


To power the upgraded system,[Beacon (opens in a new tab)](https://beaconoutdoorlighting.com/) used[Sollos commercial-grade stainless steel transformers (opens in a new tab)](https://www.hayward.com/why-hayward/explore-products/better-landscape-lighting) , chosen for their heavy-duty construction, sleek appearance, and long-term reliability. Each transformer circuit was carefully balanced to account for voltage drop across long runs, ensuring consistent light output from the front palms to the farthest oaks. This layout also allows for future expansion and easy maintenance — a hallmark of every[Beacon (opens in a new tab)](https://beaconoutdoorlighting.com/) design.


**Halco 8-Watt LED Lamps: Power & Precision**


Lighting quality depends heavily on the lamp — and for this project, Halco delivered unmatched performance.


**Why We Chose Halco:**


● High lumen output for tall palms and large canopies.


● Consistent color temperature across all fixtures.


● Tight beam control for precise aiming and balanced illumination.


● Low operating temperature, pairing perfectly with copper’s heat-dissipating properties.The result was dramatic, uniform coverage across every major landscape feature — bringing both the home and its surroundings to life. The homeowner immediately noticed the difference, describing the transformation as “night and day.”


---


**Client Experience**


After being disappointed with their previous installation, the homeowner was cautious about reinvesting. But from our first nighttime demo, it was clear that this would be different. They were thrilled with the warm, balanced glow across their landscape, the architectural cohesion between their copper lanterns and Sollos fixtures, and the bright, natural illumination of their palm canopies. They also appreciated the attention to detail and care our team brought to every phase. Today, they describe themselves as “beyond thrilled” with the finished system — both in look and performance.


---


**Results & Key Takeaways**


This project stands as a testament to[Sollos (opens in a new tab)](https://www.hayward.com/why-hayward/explore-products/better-landscape-lighting) & Halcos and commitment to excellence.


**Project Highlights:**


● Enhanced visual impact with layered, full-canopy illumination across mature palms and oaks.


● Architectural harmony through copper fixtures that complement existing details.


● Thermal advantage from faster cooling and longer lamp life due to copper construction.


● Superior performance through Halco LEDs delivering brightness and color consistency.


● Long-term reliability powered by[Sollos stainless transformers (opens in a new tab)](https://www.hayward.com/why-hayward/explore-products/better-landscape-lighting) providing steady voltage.


● A delighted client whose property truly comes alive each night.


---


**Conclusion**


When it comes to outdoor lighting, materials, design, and product quality matter as much as lumens and wattage. The Pelican Bay Beach Project exemplifies how[Beacon Outdoor Lighting (opens in a new tab)](https://beaconoutdoorlighting.com/) continues to elevate the standard for luxury estate lighting.


By combining[Sollos Landscape Lighting’s copper (opens in a new tab)](https://www.hayward.com/why-hayward/explore-products/better-landscape-lighting) craftsmanship with Halco’s advanced LED technology, we created a system that is both timeless and high-performing.


Together,[Sollos (opens in a new tab)](https://www.hayward.com/why-hayward/explore-products/better-landscape-lighting) and Halco represent what we proudly call **“The Gold Standard in Landscape** **Lighting”** — where form meets function, and artistry meets engineering. From fixtures that age gracefully to lamps that deliver enduring brilliance, this collaboration proves that outdoor lighting can be more than illumination — it can be **art that shines every night.**
